title: Desert Dunes by Moonlight
prompt: Rolling desert dunes under a full moon and a dense starfield, a small campfire with a tent glowing warm in the cold blue night. Gentle handheld drift; the fire flickers.
description: Teaches a sculpted dune heightfield on a variable-density grid, a procedural world-shader starfield, cool moonlight against warm flickering practicals, and painterly Freestyle ink lines with an exclusion collection.

brief.prompt: Rolling desert dunes under a full moon and a dense starfield, a small campfire with a tent glowing warm in the cold blue night. Gentle handheld drift; the fire flickers.

tags.lighting: cool moonlight and starfield, warm campfire practical

techniques: asymmetric dune heightfield on a non-uniform grid (kit.mesh)
world-shader starfield, moon glow and Milky Way via Voronoi and Light Path
kit.sun moonlight plus emissive moon disc on the same direction
flame tongues and point light flickering with kit.loop_noise
Freestyle linestyle modifiers: taper, distance thinning, Perlin wobble, collection exclusion
baked kit.particles grains and scrolling alpha streamer cards
translucent tent canvas lit by an interior practical
kit.handheld with a tiny sine dolly
